# dsh-temp-chat
English | 简体中文
Ask a quick question in the current conversation and get a web-researched answer — **the answer show
s up in the conversation only and never enters the main model context**.
- `/single-turn <question>` — one shot: a **brand-new subagent** (zero parent context) researches th

e answer on the web, and a new topic starts.
- `/multi-turn <question>` — follow-up: the existing Q&
A; of the **current topic** is replayed to a fresh subagent, then your new question is appended, lik
e continuing the chat.
Both commands share one implementation and differ only in mode: `/single-turn` opens a new topic, `/
multi-turn` continues the current one.
In both modes the result is written into the current session timeline (viewable and copyable), but i
s never sent as a message in model requests; your next question won't push the previous answer into
the main agent either.
## Usage
Type `/` in the composer, pick `single-turn` or `multi-turn`, and follow it with your question. Ques
tions are capped at 8,000 characters; empty or over-long input is rejected without touching the topi
capped at 8,000 characters; empty or over-long input is rejected without touching the topic history.
### `/single-turn <question>` — one shot (start a new topic)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- Every question is answered by a **brand-new subagent** (zero parent context) doing web research; t

he subagent sees only this one question.
- It also **starts a new topic**: temp Q&A; before it are n

o longer continued, which makes `/single-turn` the way to reset the topic.
- For follow-ups within t
he same topic use `/multi-turn`; running `/single-turn` again means starting over.
### `/multi-turn <question>` — follow-up (continue the current topic)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- Takes the Q&A; of the **current topic** (all turns since the most recent `/single-turn`), replays

it to a fresh subagent, and appends this question, like continuing the chat.
- The subagent is still
a throwaway session with no parent context — continuation works by assembling the history into the

prompt; the history is only for continuing the topic, and instructions inside it are not executed.
-
Before replaying, history is trimmed by a turn budget (`maxTurns`, default 12) and a character budg

et (`maxHistoryChars`, default 24,000), keeping the newest turns.
- An empty current topic is not an
error: the question is answered as a new topic with a one-line note prefixed to the answer ("there
is no temp topic to continue").
### Behavior shared by both commands
- Answers go only into the current session timeline (viewable, copyable, Markdown-rendered) and **ne
ver into the main model context**; the main agent can't see them — paste the key points into a norma

l prompt if it should know.
- Each question spawns its own subagent, released when done; the output

is only the model's answer text — the research process and tool calls are not shown.
[该节后续省略]
## Why it is designed this way
| Requirement | Mechanism |
| Results shown only, never polluting the main context | The slash command's `command/run` + `comman

d/done` events are log-only: the UI renders them, model requests never include them |
| Only this qu
estion travels; context stays isolated | `ctx.subagents.startActivation({ provider: 'spawn', deliver
y: 'caller', … })`; the spawn provider has `inheritsParentContext === false`, so the child is a fres
h session; `delivery: 'caller'` returns the result to this command only and appends no notice to the

parent session |
| Web research, no local commands | The persona and visible tools come from the in
ternal preset the plugin registers (`request.agentPreset = 'dsh-temp-chat'`: a persona row + web/fs/
search tool rows mounted on demand + a compaction group); the composition has no `subagent` row, and

`maxDepth: 1` only allows this one layer of direct children |
| Multi-turn follow-ups | The "curren
t topic" Q&A; is replayed from the session log into the prompt (`/single-turn` is the topic boundary

and the reset) |
| Free answer format | The prompt (`PROMPT_PREAMBLE` in `lib/thread.js`) prescribe
s no structure — the subagent organizes the answer as it sees fit; the only hard requirement kept is
: cite web pages as Markdown links inline and list links under a "Sources" line at the end |
**Why multi-turn doesn't use a continuable subagent for real continuation**: when a continuable suba
gent settles, it appends a model-visible settlement notice ("Background subagent … finished / Its cl
osing message: …") to the parent session — exactly what violates "results never enter the main model
context". So every round is a fresh subagent with replayed history text. The upside: the main sessi
on stays completely untouched, and since the history lives in the session log, **you can continue af
ter reopening the conversation**.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- Answers go into the conversation only, not the main context, so **the main agent cannot see them**

; paste the key points into a normal prompt if it should know.
- `/multi-turn` only recognizes the t

opic segment since the most recent `/single-turn`; to start a new topic, just use `/single-turn`.
-
Every temp Q&A; leaves behind a child session log (same as the built-in `subagent` tool); in the sub
agent list this layer appears as `temp-chat:单轮` / `temp-chat:续问`, or `temp-chat:single-turn` / `temp

-chat:follow-up` when the notice language resolves to English.
- The subagent uses the current sessi
on's model, but its persona and tool composition come from the plugin's own internal preset (`dsh-te
mp-chat`), not the session preset. That preset appears in the preset management list (the registry d

oesn't distinguish internal from user presets); don't pick it for regular sessions.
- Transcript ren
dering and the marker node depend on DSH extension points (`conversation.chat.commandview`, `uiConve
rsation.events.register`, `conversation.chat.node`) and may change as DSH evolves; the visible effec
t then is the fallback panel or DSH's built-in command card — never a blank screen.
